title: Billing: remove per-request rounding in invoice aggregator; round at invoice line-item aggregation (ADR-027)
author: Cole Summers
description: Context: Finance flagged persistent small deltas between Console usage totals and invoice line items. Root cause was a mismatch in rounding policy: the invoice aggregator was rounding metered usage on a per-request basis prior to aggregation, while ADR-027 specifies rounding should occur only after aggregation (per invoice line item / aggregation window) to avoid systematic drift. This PR updates the invoice aggregation pipeline to stop rounding at the request-event stage and instead perform rounding once at the end of aggregation per (account_id, invoice_period, meter, model, region, endpoint_type, pricing_plan). Summary of changes: (1) Replace per-request rounding with high-precision accumulation (Decimal) in the aggregator. (2) Apply the documented rounding rule at finalization: round_half_up to the meter’s billing precision (tokens: whole units; embeddings/rerank: whole units) after summing raw usage across the aggregation window. (3) Add regression tests covering boundary conditions (0.5 cases), mixed streaming partials, and retries/outcomes where some events are non-billable. (4) Add a one-time diagnostic log field (behind feature flag) to emit both raw_total_units and billed_units for targeted accounts during rollout. Implementation notes: Previous behavior: billed_units = sum(round_per_request(event.units)). New behavior: billed_units = round(sum(event.units)). This matches ADR-027 and eliminates systematic bias from repeated small fractional values. Risk/rollout: Low-to-medium. While the rounding change is expected to reduce invoice/console mismatch, it can change historical totals by small amounts. We will deploy behind `BILLING_AGG_ROUND_AT_FINALIZE` for 48h, compare aggregates via the daily reconciliation job, and only then enable by default. Backfill is NOT included here; that is handled in ENG-4826 after Finance sign-off. Testing: unit tests added for the aggregator + golden fixtures for a representative invoice period; CI includes deterministic Decimal-based tests to avoid float nondeterminism. References: ADR-027 (meter rounding and streaming accounting), Finance thread 1707249911 (rounding confusion), INT-944 (close checklist: add pre-invoice meter health check).

billing/aggregator: finalize() applies meter-specific rounding at line-item level
tests: add rounding regression fixtures (half-up, mixed endpoints, streaming partials)

Meter rounding utilities and shared billing math helpers
Unit/regression test suite for billing aggregation
illustrative_diff_snippet: Before (simplified): total += round_units(event.units, precision=meter.precision) After (simplified): total_raw += Decimal(event.units); total_billed = round_units(total_raw, precision=meter.precision, mode='half_up')
review_conversation: Logan Wright (review): Can we confirm this matches ADR-027 exactly (rounding mode + place where rounding is applied)? Also, any float nondeterminism risk in the new path?

Cole Summers (author): Yep—rounding is now applied only in `finalize_line_item()` using round_half_up. Internals use Decimal end-to-end (parsing event units into Decimal immediately) so we avoid float drift. I added tests that fail under float accumulation to lock this in.
Emily Stone (review): Finance question: will this change invoice totals mid-cycle? We need to avoid surprises for Feb invoices. Can we ship behind a flag and run reconciliation first?

Cole Summers (author): Agreed. Default remains OFF. Plan: deploy with flag OFF, enable for internal test account + two low-risk accounts, compare console/invoice aggregates for 48h, then enable more broadly after sign-off. No backfill in this PR; ENG-4826 covers audit/backfill with Finance approval.
Nadia Rahman (review): One concern: are we certain embeddings/rerank should be whole-unit rounding? Some partners report fractional units in raw telemetry.

Cole Summers (author): Raw telemetry can be fractional in intermediate conversions, but billing precision is still whole units per meter definition. Added explicit per-meter precision mapping (tokens/embeddings/rerank all 0 decimals) and tests. If we later introduce fractional billing for any meter, we’ll update the meter dictionary + precision map in one place.
Logan Wright (review): Please add a test for repeated 0.1 units across many events; per-event rounding would previously drop these entirely.
Cole Summers (author): Added fixture `adr027_case_many_small_fractions.jsonl` + expected golden output; test demonstrates old behavior underbilled by ~3 units over the sample window.
Emily Stone (approval): Approved with flag plan + no backfill in this PR. Please link in release notes for close checklist update.
release_notes: Billing: invoice aggregator rounding now matches ADR-027 by rounding after aggregation per invoice line item (removes per-request rounding drift). Adds regression tests and feature-flagged rollout support.
follow_ups: ENG-4826: backfill + audit evidence for a targeted window after Finance sign-off
ENG-4825: verify Console usage page alignment after rounding change rolls out
